description: With 100 days remaining until the November general election, Democratic U.S. Senate candidate Mary Peltola's campaign says it is building statewide momentum through grassroots organizing, labor support, and an Alaska-focused message as she seeks to unseat Republican Sen. Dan Sullivan.
